title: The Subtle Art Of Not Giving A F*ck

questions.q: Which Stoic principle does Mark Manson emphasize?
questions.why: Stoicism focuses on controlling what one can.

questions.q: What does the author say about certainty?
Why does the book advise against obsessing over legacy?
questions.why: Obsessing on legacy wastes present time.

questions.q: What mode of operation does the author describe as satisfying?
Which value category should one only hold if it is controllable?
questions.why: Only hold values you can control.
